dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: This is the bedroom. What do you think?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɪs ɪz ðə ˈbɛdruːm. ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's nice, but there's no mirror.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈnaɪs, bʌt ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˈmɪrər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's OK. I'll buy a mirror for you.
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈbaɪ ə ˈmɪrər fər juː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. And there aren't any pillows or blankets.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ənd ðɛr ˈɑːrnt ˈɛni ˈpɪloʊz ɔːr ˈblæŋkɪts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, you have to buy pillows and blankets.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, juː ˈhæf tə ˈbaɪ ˈpɪloʊz ənd ˈblæŋkɪts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ɪz ðɛr ˈwaɪfaɪ ɪn ðə ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, there isn't any Wi-Fi in the rooms. It's only downstairs.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðɛr ˈɪzənt ˈɛni ˈwaɪfaɪ ɪn ðə ˈruːmz. ɪts ˈoʊnli ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! I need Wi-Fi for my homework.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈniːd ˈwaɪfaɪ fər maɪ ˈhoʊmwɜːrk.
